description:
We are a team representing London South Bank University Ajman. 

United by the belief that technology must be a force for global good, we are tackling the "Field Shift" challenge to support our most vital community: Farmers. Our project leverages NASA’s Earth observation data to help agriculture adapt to a rapidly changing climate. By translating complex environmental data into accessible, actionable insights, our goal is to empower farmers to make resilient, sustainable planting decisions that protect their livelihoods and secure our future food supply.
